name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details better than standard upscalers, giving a measurable quality bump without extra compute. Trade-off: it adds a small step to the workflow, but the clarity gain outweighs the minor slowdown.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is motion blur in source frames, not resolution loss—adding detail to blurry faces just sharpens the blur. Instead, test Flowframes’ VFI module first; if it reduces motion blur before upscaling, the clarity gain from any upscaler will compound. Settle it by running a blind A/B test on 10 sample clips: measure face fidelity drop with/without VFI, then upscale both with the same method.
